5,105 confirmed cases and 2,420 confirmed deaths in DR Congo, as of 17 August 2026 (CDC). The fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.

Ebola is not airborne and does not spread by casual contact. The CDC reports no US cases from this outbreak and puts the risk to the American public at low.

40 days from response activation to 1,000 confirmed cases. The 2018 Ebola outbreak, in the same country, took about 235 days.

Source: CDC, 20 August 2026.

Ebola is not airborne. It spreads through direct contact with the blood or body fluids of someone sick, or someone who has died — which is why the people most at risk are those caring for the sick and burying the dead.

Ebola is not airborne and does not spread by casual contact. The CDC reports no US cases from this outbreak and puts the risk to the American public at low.

There is an Ebola vaccine and it works. Ervebo is licensed against Zaire ebolavirus. This outbreak is a different species — Bundibugyo — and CEPI states there are no licensed vaccines for it.

That is the headline. It is not the reason it is spreading.

Three Red Cross volunteers handled bodies on 27 March, on a mission unrelated to Ebola. Nobody knew there was an outbreak. It was not declared until 15 May.

Seven weeks in which the virus was moving, and no system existed to see it.

Named from the IFRC statement of 23 May 2026.
